description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'LoginLogServiceTest' for the 'LoginService' class within the OrangeHRM authentication system. It tests the behaviors related to login log management, including saving login logs and adding OIDC logins, by mocking dependencies and asserting expected outcomes.

classes.name: LoginLogServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LoginService's login logging functionalities within the OrangeHRM authentication module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of LoginService before each test.

methods.name: testGetLoginLogDao
methods.description: Tests that getLoginLogDao() returns an instance of LoginLogDao.

methods.name: testSaveLoginLog
methods.description: Tests the process of saving a login log, including mocks for user retrieval and session handling, and verifies the login log details.

methods.name: testAddOIDCLogin
methods.description: Tests the addition of an OIDC login, asserting that the login log correctly records user info and timestamp.
